def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import openpyxl
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('data/archeology/input/climateMeasurements.xlsx')
    ws = wb.active
    
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    
    for i, row in enumerate(rows[:100]):
        if row[0] and 'ODP' in str(row[0]) and i > 0:
            header_idx = i - 1
            break
    
    headers = rows[header_idx]
    data_rows = rows[header_idx + 1:]
    
    df = pd.DataFrame(data_rows, columns=headers)
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    return df

def process(filter_valid_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Sort by dust proxy (ascending), then by wet-dry index (ascending)
    sorted_df = filter_valid_data.sort_values(
        by=['ODP 967 Dust proxy', 'ODP 967 wet-dry index'],
        ascending=[True, True]
    )
    
    # Get the first row (smallest dust proxy, then smallest wet-dry index)
    result_row = sorted_df.iloc[0]
    
    # Extract calcium value and round to 4 decimal places
    ca_value = round(result_row['Ca'], 4)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({'Ca_ppm': [ca_value]})
